items.title: Colgate-Palmolive India's quarterly profit rises on growing demand for oral care
items.summary: July 29 (Reuters) - Colgate-Palmolive India reported a rise in quarterly profit on Wednesday, helped by healthy demand in its core oral care product portfolio as well as premium offerings.

items.title: Market watchers weigh chances of a surprise Fed rate hike tomorrow
items.summary: Investing.com -- In just over 24 hours, Kevin Warsh’s Fed will announce its interest rate decision. While the consensus is for the Fed to remain on hold, a growing number of market watchers expect a surprise rate hike. Citadel Securities is one of those outliers, with the firm’s head of macro strategy Frank Flight expecting a 25-basis-point hike. Overall, 32% of market participants expect a hike tomorrow. This is down from yesterday, but up sharply from last week.

items.title: U.S. Senators to vote on new Russia and Iran energy sanctions bill
items.summary: Investing.com -- A bipartisan group of senators announced a deal Tuesday on legislation that would allow President Donald Trump to impose additional restrictions on major buyers of Russian energy and Iran.

items.title: Colgate's Pre-Q2 Earnings: What's Likely to Shape the Results?
items.summary: CL's Q2 results are likely to show sales and EPS growth, supported by emerging markets, innovation and Hill's, while inflation pressures margins.

items.title: 5 Dividend Kings Continued to Pay and Raise Dividends Through Every Market Crash Since Black Monday
items.summary: Black Monday wiped out 22% of the market in a single day, and most investors never saw it coming. A small group of companies not only survived that crash and every major meltdown since, but kept sending bigger checks to shareholders each time the panic peaked.

items.title: This Dividend King Stock Just Offered a Superb Buy-the-Dip Opportunity
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive's current dip is relatively shallow, but it might be risky waiting for it to deepen.

items.title: Burnham says he will challenge Trump when UK interests demand it - BBC reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he was prepared to challenge U.S. President Donald Trump when necessary to protect the UK’s national interests, according to his first major interview since taking office, conducted by the BBC.

items.title: BofA warns oil volatility could force c. banks to abandon look-through’ policy
items.summary: Investing.com - Persistent oil price volatility caused by global shipping disruptions and geopolitical friction is threatening to entrench core inflation, creating a tough dilemma for major central banks, according to a report by Bank of America (BofA) Global Research. The Wall Street bank warned that standard monetary policy, which typically "looks through" short-term supply-side commodity shocks, may be inadequate after five years of above-target inflation.
